facts.text: Thomas Aquinas College offers an integrated four-year classical curriculum with no majors, minors, or electives, where students read foundational texts and participate in seminar discussions in classes of 15 to 18 students.

sources.title: USA Today ranks Thomas Aquinas College Among “Best 10 ...
sources.quote: At Thomas Aquinas College, there are no majors, no minors, or electives because all students acquire a broad and fully integrated liberal education.
